language_shifts.shift: Forward-looking statements in Q4 (filed 2018-05-03) expand to include explicit mention of 'sales growth of our intra-oral scanner sales in international markets' and 'impact of the U.S. Tax Cuts and Jobs Act' — topics absent from earlier quarters — signaling broadening disclosure scope as new risks materialized
Q5 (filed 2018-08-02) adds 'our intention to open additional Invisalign stores' to forward-looking statements, introducing a new consumer-direct channel commitment not present in prior quarters

Q6 (filed 2018-11-01) replaces 'Invisalign stores' language with 'Invisalign Experience program locations,' softening brand and narrowing scope following the SDC dispute — a linguistic retreat from a prior commitment

G-Series product innovation language shifts from specific 'G7 delivers better upper lateral control, improved root control' feature descriptions in Q1-Q2 to broader 'solutions and features to treat a wide range of cases - from simple to complex' framing in Q3, reducing feature specificity

red_flags: Invisalign Teen with mandibular advancement remained 'pending 510(k) clearance' and 'not yet available in the United States' for all six quarters observed (Q1 2017 through Q3 2018), despite being available internationally since March 2017 — US clearance received only in October 2018 per Q6 filing, indicating a prolonged regulatory lag not quantified or guided on

SmileDirectClub incremental revenue commitment from Q1 2017 was silently dropped from forward-looking statements language by Q4 2018 period filings following the February 2018 SDC dispute notice, shifting from a specific revenue growth driver to an unmentioned litigation contingency

Regional treatment planning facilities (Chengdu June 2017, Cologne August 2017) were committed to in Q1 2017 as strategic initiatives; Q1-Q3 only reference 'financial and strategic benefits' without facility-specific milestones, and the language 'anticipated timing of such facilities being operational' was added only in Q2, suggesting the specific timing commitment was made after the fact

Invisalign Go North America launch was committed to for Q1 2017 in the prior 10-K but no confirmation of that launch appears in Q1 2017 MD&A, with Q2-Q3 filings describing it as available only in 'core European markets' and 'certain markets in North America and Asia Pacific' — partial delivery only

new_risks.risk: SmileDirectClub non-compete dispute and potential forced redemption of membership interest
new_risks.key_phrase: SDC Financial LLC has notified Align that its members (other than Align) seek to exercise a right to repurchase all of Align s SDC Financial LLC membership interests for a purchase price equal to the current capital account balance of Align

new_risks.risk: Invisalign store pilot program and consumer-direct channel regulatory and commercial risk
new_risks.key_phrase: SDC Entities also allege that Align has breached confidentiality provisions applicable to the SDC Financial LLC members and demands that Align cease all activities related to the Invisalign store pilot project

new_risks.risk: U.S. Tax Cuts and Jobs Act transition tax and deferred tax remeasurement
new_risks.key_phrase: recorded a provisional amount of $84.3 million additional income tax expense in the fourth quarter of 2017

new_risks.risk: Expanded manufacturing commitments in China (Ziyang investment agreement) and Costa Rica real estate creating capital lock-in
new_risks.key_phrase: committed to invest a minimum of $46.0 million in Ziyang, China over five years to establish manufacturing operations

new_risks.risk: Served market size estimate expansion — from 5 million applicable cases to 6 million, with a new 300 million at-home market segment identified
new_risks.key_phrase: approximately 300 million people with malocclusion could benefit from straightening their teeth, but are unlikely to seek treatment through a doctor s office

escalated_risks.prior_language: We are exposed to fluctuations in currency exchange rates, which could negatively affect our financial condition
escalated_risks.current_language: We are exposed to fluctuations in currency exchange rates, which could negatively affect our financial condition and results of operations — language unchanged in form but substantive exposure increased as international revenues grew from a smaller base to over 50% of total revenue

escalated_risks.risk: Manufacturing capacity and growth-related operational risk
escalated_risks.prior_language: risks related to excess or constrained capacity at our existing facilities
escalated_risks.current_language: risks related to excess or constrained capacity at our existing facilities — retained but now accompanied by active capital commitments totaling over $97 million in Costa Rica and China, elevating real exposure versus prior year

disappeared_risks.risk: Invisalign Go North America launch execution risk — prior year flagged imminent North America launch as uncertain
disappeared_risks.likely_reason: materialized — product launched in North America during 2017

disappeared_risks.risk: iTero Element launch and market adoption uncertainty — prior year referenced initial iTero Element market introduction risk
disappeared_risks.likely_reason: resolved — iTero Element established in market, risk language normalized

corroborations.claim: Digital dentistry and intraoral scanning represent an emerging, high-growth opportunity with low current penetration
corroborations.evidence: Competitor A (life sciences instruments sector) corroborates the broader theme of digital workflow adoption in healthcare: 'Revenue in the diagnostics and genomics business increased 10 percent in 2018 when compared to 2017' and references growing demand for application-focused solutions across laboratory and clinical workflows — consistent with the target's assertion that digital scanning is displacing analog impression-taking

job3.analyst_note: Competitor A (Agilent Technologies, life sciences instruments) and Competitor B (AbbVie, pharmaceutical) are not direct competitors in the orthodontic clear aligner or intraoral scanner markets. No meaningful direct competitive contradiction or corroboration is possible from these filings. The target's competitive claims — quantified utilization rates, named product launches, specific market share statistics, and named geographic penetration data — are highly specific, but they cannot be validated or contradicted by the supplied comparator filings. Confidence in competitive position assessment is low due to incompatible comparator selection.

topics_dropped: SmileDirectClub as incremental revenue driver — referenced in Q1-Q3 forward-looking statements as 'our expectation that the SmileDirectClub, LLC transaction will be incremental to revenue growth in 2017'; dropped entirely from forward-looking statements by Q4 2018 following the February 2018 SDC dispute

G-Series product innovation specifics — Q1 forward-looking statements include detailed G7 feature descriptions; by Q3-Q4 the focus shifts to broader portfolio themes with G-Series no longer mentioned by name in the strategic overview

notable_shifts.observation: Forward-looking statements list is relatively concise (6 topic areas); language uses 'our expectation that the SmileDirectClub, LLC transaction will be incremental to revenue growth in 2017' — highly specific and time-bound claim with named partner

Forward-looking statements list expands to add 'the anticipated timing of such facilities being operational' for regional facilities — more specific operational commitment added mid-year, consistent with facilities having opened in June 2017

Product innovation section shifts from enumerating specific G7 feature claims to stating 'Our focus is to develop solutions and features to treat a wide range of cases - from simple to complex' — a broadening, slightly less specific framing that may signal G-Series cycle exhaustion

Significant expansion of forward-looking statement scope: adds 'sales growth of our intra-oral scanner sales in international markets,' 'impact of the U.S. Tax Cuts and Jobs Act,' and 'manufacturing facilities' — three new disclosure topics, signaling management is actively managing new material risk areas; SmileDirectClub language quietly dropped

Forward-looking statements explicitly add 'our intention to open additional Invisalign stores' — a bold new consumer-direct channel commitment introduced at the same time the SDC dispute was already known internally, suggesting management was signaling confidence in that strategy despite legal headwinds

'Invisalign stores' replaced by 'Invisalign Experience program locations' in forward-looking statements — a rebranding of the consumer-direct concept following SDC dispute; tone remains confident but the specific channel language is softened, representing measurable linguistic hedging on a previously prominent commitment
